sentences.text: Adlercreutzia was proposed as a new genus with the single species Adlercreutzia equolifaciens, for strains that metabolise isoflavones to equol and were isolated from human faeces.

The characterised strains were asaccharolytic, obligately anaerobic, non-spore-forming, non-motile, Gram-positive coccobacilli related to Eggerthella sinensis by about 93 percent 16S ribosomal RNA gene sequence similarity.

In a 60-day randomised probiotic trial, shotgun metagenomics showed Adlercreutzia equolifaciens among beneficial commensal bacteria that increased in participants with a lower baseline Gut Microbiome Wellness Index.

That study also reported that Adlercreutzia equolifaciens promoted production of palmitoyl serinol, a metabolite the authors associated with improved wellness index and preventive benefits in blood glucose.
